svg.text: lamport.json · the structured proof the model returned
1. Fix a finite index type ι and coefficients x : ι → ℝ satisfying ∑ i, x i
2. Apply AgtXIv.RoM.normalized_l1 to x and the normalization hypothesis;
project its first conjunct to obtain 1 ≤ AgtXIv.RoM.l1Cost x.
3. Unfold l1Cost to express the bound as 1 ≤ ∑ i, |x i|.
alignment_notes
· Fintype represents the finite index type; x has real coefficients and the
hypothesis preserves their sum being one. No nonnegativity or nonempty-
index assumption is added.
· The explicit sum of absolute values represents the source's coefficient
cost. Only the lower-bound conjunct of normalized_l1 is used.
· This statement concerns the coefficient bound alone; it does not assert
primal feasibility or strong duality.
